gates.notes: Offline simulator optionally journals marks/intents/fills/funding/cancels and risk rejections; refuses nonempty-journal restart until full replay is implemented. D1 accepted review checkpoints: long/short add/reduce/flip PnL conservation, full reversal fee basis, legacy equity digest isolation, no duplicate agent stack. New tests require CI validation; integration into existing Nautilus agents remains a D2 gate. 2026-10-25 hardening: shared per-trade participation budget, trade/mark distinct event kinds, event-time minute seals, strict EEA candle schema, separate mark tick precision, global event ID dedup, exact CSV replay times, SQLite append-only triggers; added regression tests. These are D1 fixes, not broker-grade fill or recoverable OMS evidence. Exact OFFLINE-only journal replay is now implemented using immutable session fingerprints and event-by-event deterministic recomputation; it rejects missing derived fills and mismatched fee/risk inputs. No external broker recovery is implied. 2026-10-25 standalone broker-neutral pure preflight: evaluate 3**N subset outcomes (0/50/100% fills) across max six pending orders, quote-denominated collateral, fee/slippage, stressed mark risk, margin, drawdown, funding buffer, monetary loss, and strict missing marks. This is a conservative screening oracle, not a certified all-fractions worst-case or a Nautilus actor bridge.

gates.note: The public OKX EEA candles CLI is read-only. Accurate derivative trading still requires quote, independent mark/index and funding sources, venue qualifications, immutable Parquet catalogs and Nautilus bridge. See institutional flow audit. Local immutable daily confirmed-candle Parquet partitions with SHA-256 and gap metadata are implemented; this is not a complete raw L2/trade/mark/funding replay source. Public recent trades (including taker side) and independent swap mark snapshots are now parsed from EEA-hosted endpoints. They are not quote/L2/funding feeds and do not qualify account region or complete replay coverage. Initial exact read-only TradeTick/Bar conversions to pinned Nautilus event types are implemented, with receipt-time causality checks. No bound Nautilus CryptoPerpetual instrument or broker execution agent is qualified. 2026-10-25 extension: conservative EEA read-only REST multi-level book snapshot and indicative funding parser, bounded paginated 1m history, explicit non-synchronized provenance, missing-minute reporting, shared CLI/browser preview, and fail-closed validation tests. These snapshots cannot settle funding or determine maker queue placement; complete streaming L2 and authenticated account capabilities remain missing.
